comparison.objective: Commission a shock absorber from measured carriage response vs singulate four parcels onto a sorter lane.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine tool use and iterative mechanical tuning vs carton extraction, handover, orientation, and spaced placement.
comparison.success_condition: Repeatable safe stops without bottoming, overload, rebound, or drift vs cartons flat, single-file, unstacked, and separated by at least 10 cm.
comparison.reason: Parcel singulation tests spatial organization and cross-arm handover, not adjustment-and-lock commissioning.
